about_the_game:
Story & Background

Eternal Lust: Zenyh City invites you to step into the shoes of David as you embark on a captivating journey to the enigmatic land of Zenyh City. This immersive role-playing adventure combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and character development to create a truly unique experience. Interact with the environment, solve challenges and puzzles, and enhance Dravid's talents and perks, all of which will play a crucial role in your dating encounters.

Demo Features

  • 2 unique gorgeous girls out of 5 in this demo with different personalities, preferences, and backgrounds. You will experience their first part of the main story, life, and so on. And various interactions follow up with the character.

  • Dating 2 girls with match 3 puzzle to increase affinity and unlock special scene

  • A Fusion of Medieval and Sci-Fi Worlds

    Experience a unique universe where the ancient meets the futuristic, blending the best of both worlds.

  • Preview Exclusive Sexy CG Scenes

    Unlock and preview exclusive sexy CG images for both girls right from the start, offering a glimpse into their special moments.

  • Strategic Match-3 Puzzles

    Make the right decisions in unique match-3 puzzles to optimize your dating experience and take your relationships to the next level.

  • Shopping & Gifting: Explore the city’s markets to buy items and gifts for the many kawaii girls you’ll encounter.

The full game is coming soon, featuring all 5 stunning companions, ten stunning CG scenes, and many other match-3 gameplay modes.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 18 years old.
The game contains explicit adult themes, including nudity, violence, and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
